cards.text: The Magi have gone. Then an angel of the Lord appears in a dream to Joseph, Mary's husband (Matthew 1:16). And friend, this angel did NOT come for small talk, because the first words out the gate are "Get up!"

cards.question: The angel tells Joseph to take the Child and His mother and flee. Where to?

cards.text: Egypt it is, and the angel adds, "Stay there until I tell you…" No end date, no "back by Friday," just stay until further notice.

cards.question: The angel tells Joseph that Herod is going to search for the Child so he can worship Him.
Joseph takes the Child and His mother and leaves for Egypt. When does he go?

cards.text: By NIGHT, friend. The angel says get up, and Joseph gets up and goes, no "can this wait till morning?"

cards.question: Joseph's family stays in Egypt until the ___ of Herod.

cards.text: Matthew says this fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I called My Son."

cards.question: Herod sees that the Magi outwitted him, and he is filled with ___.

cards.text: Now the story turns dark, friend. Herod sends orders and puts to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who are two years old and under.

cards.question: Herod's order covers boys two years old and under. What does he go by to set that age?

answers.text: The time he learned from the Magi
A word from the chief priests

cards.text: Matthew says this fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet Jeremiah. A voice is heard in Ramah, and it's Rachel, Jacob's wife from long ago (Genesis 29:28), weeping for her children.

cards.question: In Jeremiah's words, Rachel refuses to be comforted, because her children are no more.

cards.text: Then Herod dies, and over in Egypt an angel of the Lord appears to Joseph in a dream again. You already know the first words: "Get up!"

cards.question: The angel tells Joseph to take the Child and His mother and go to the land of ___.
Why can Joseph bring the Child back now, according to the angel?

answers.text: Those seeking the Child's life are dead
Egypt is no longer safe for them
The people of Israel are asking for Him

cards.text: So Joseph gets up and takes the Child and His mother to the land of Israel, his second big move on an angel's word. Me, I need three reminders and a sticky note just to take out the trash.
Herod's gone, friend, but the family business isn't. Joseph learns that Archelaus is reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod.

cards.question: Archelaus, Herod's son, is now reigning in Judea. How does Joseph feel about going there?
Before Joseph withdraws to the district of Galilee, he is warned in a dream.
In Galilee, Joseph goes and lives in a town called ___.

cards.text: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophets: "He will be called a Nazarene." Three dreams, three moves, friend, and most nights all I dream about is chocolate chips.
